notes: Official lists found (read 2026-11-05): (1) ISA register of payment-service licensees "נותני שירות המפוקחים על ידי רשות ניירות ערך", 42 entries, latest entry modified 2026-10-29: https://www.new.isa.gov.il/nav-index/supervised-information-payments/tax-tax-payments-faqs-6873706a7eb22 ; (2) ISA continuation-of-activity register (sections 81(a)-(c) of the Payment Services and Payment Initiation Law 5783-2023), 40 entries: https://www.new.isa.gov.il/nav-index/supervised-information-payments/company-registration ; (3) ISA register of financial-information (open-banking) licensees, 28 entries: https://www.new.isa.gov.il/nav-index/supervised-api/informationapi ; (4) Bank of Israel page "Supervised Banking Corporations and Merchant Acquirers" (Isracard, Max It Finance, Cal, CardCom, Tranzila, Premium Express, Diners Club Israel per a search extract; our browser was stopped by the BoI bot check, so the page was not read directly): https://www.boi.org.il/en/economic-roles/supervision-and-regulation/list_supervised/. Regulatory frame (BoI press release 2024-07-18): the Payment Services and Payment Initiation Law took effect in early June 2024; new acquirers are supervised and licensed by the ISA; existing non-prudential acquirers (such as Tranzila) had up to 18 months to move to ISA supervision — Tranzila and Cardcom both show ISA licences dated 2025-12-02. The big card companies (Isracard, Max, Cal) remain Bank of Israel acquirers/payment companies (per a search extract of BoI material; not opened). Rows with licence = null are gateways/aggregators we found no licence entry for in the two ISA registers; this does not prove they are unlicensed, only that no entry was seen. Fees: only fees printed on a vendor page we opened are recorded; most vendors publish none. Users figures are company claims (grade C) with units as printed; "tens of thousands" / "thousands" phrases were turned into ranges by us and say so in the note. url_verified=false means we did not open the site ourselves (URL taken from the ISA register or well-known domain).
